emotional_tone: Premium, trustworthy, high-performance hardware, intimate but precise.

data_and_timers.style: tracking-tight, used for countdowns, live queue numbers, device metrics

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) for the dashboard. Use 1px #222225 borders on #161618 panels. Avoid heavy drop shadows; use 1px top inner borders to simulate hardware bezel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on the background to make it feel like physical matte plastic/metal.
visual_enhancers.glow: Neon glow effects strictly reserved for active states (e.g. drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)] on active sliders or drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,42,95,0.8)] on the Stop button).

grids_layouts.admin_dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid) for device connections, link generation, and active user stats. Use col-span-3 for main activity, col-span-1 for link generation panel.
grids_layouts.guest_console: Mobile-first, single-column control stack. Massive Start/Stop button at bottom (sticky), sliders stacked in the center, large prominent countdown timer at the top.

sliders.instructions: Use Shadcn slider but override track to be #222225 and active range to be Electric Cyan (#00E5FF). The thumb should be a larger, easily grabbable hardware-like pill or circle.

big_action_button.instructions: For Start/Stop. Must be massive (h-20 or larger), full width. Red/Crimson when active to signify STOP. Include pulse animation on active.

live_queue.instructions: A vertical list of users. Active user highlighted with primary color and glowing dot. Waitlist users muted.

timer_display.instructions: Massive JetBrains Mono text (text-5xl or text-6xl), centered, glowing cyan if > 1 min, pulsing red if < 1 min.

motion.timer: Every second tick should feel precise.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against #161618 is at least 4.5:1. Primary Cyan (#00E5FF) and Red (#FF2A5F) must be tested against dark backgrounds.
accessibility.controls: Sliders and huge buttons must be operable via keyboard.
accessibility.data_testid: Required on all sliders, Start/Stop button, queue items, and connect device buttons.

media.instructions: Use abstract neon as a very subtle, low opacity (10-15%) blur behind the main console to give depth. Use hardware texture blended with base color for panel backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard and guest console as distinct views.
Implement Web Bluetooth logic in a dedicated service/hook (mocked where actual hardware isn't available, but preserve real API usage structure).
For the Guest Console, emphasize a physical hardware feel. It should look like an expensive remote control.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for cards/panels. Use solid #161618.
Avoid typical generic SaaS aesthetics. The app must feel like an intimate hardware bridge.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for floating elements.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
Do not center align the app container text by default.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
